name: HIEP
title: Visual Artist & Designer
occupation: 2010 - now: Independent consultant/advisor/trainer in image solution for VTVs, VTC-Intecom, VinEdu/Motion/Retail, TienphongBank, Hyperlogy, Niteco, Victorymedia, ...
2010 - now: Assuming the title of Academic Head at FPT-Arena
2012: Guest lecturer at the London College for Fashion Studies and Keuka Program - ISVNU;
2008 - 2010: Founding lecturer at Omega - the first experimental school for design in Hanoi;
2003 - 2005: Graphic designer at CDT, HGK, i-Pro. Clients served: Sofitel Metropole Hanoi, Melia, Sheraton, Horizon (Swiss Bell), Liberty Mutual, Path-VN, EU-VN, HaiLong Junk, Lexim, ...
2000 - 2004: Lecturer of academic drawing and visual theory at 360° fine arts studio.
logoAndBranding: One of very few designers who directs logo design at both best cost saving in production/application and catching customers at highest effectiveness based on modern material visual method.
Prioritize the importance of key visual systematically, which helps strongly recognizing the brand even without the logo.
Extensive art/culture foundation is a big advantage in high-class and not-easy-to-do logos.
artsAndDesign: 2014 - 2018: Top 1¼ badges and top 5% most viewed portfolios on CGSociety - one of the most professional world-class computer art communities;
2014: Winner in Graphics and Visual Communication Design Category - "A Prime" International Design Award - Como Italy;
2013: 3rd prize in Train Your Brain - the global contest in computer art hosted by The Art Department - USA and Deviantart.com - the largest online art community worldwide;
2011: Illustrations for the fairy tale "Tu Thuc" featured at the mentioned renowned page Deviantart.com;
2010: Awarded for "Book cover set of the year" by Nha Nam publishing house;
2009: Advisor in anatomy and environment drawing for "Gray matter" - an Euro point-and-click game developed by Wizarbox and published by DTP entertainment (partly produced at Phoenix - Hanoi based);
2009: "Unreal 99.9%" and "Nho" - 2 group exhibitions in digital painting - HCM City;
2008: The matte-painting artwork "Ha Long bay" featured on Zidean - the largest online art community in Vietnam then;
2004: In team with 2 artists Nguyen Ngoc Quan & Ha Lien Hoang to draw portrait for nearly 200 guests in one single evening - live performance at Honda's event "Hello Vietnam";
tutoringAndAcademic: 2010 - 2013: Promoted famous artists/lecturers from Europe and America to bring their workshops in calligraphy, artbook, "game jam", design thinking, ... to local creative community.
2006 - 2012: Lead FPT-Arena's annual creative exhibition "Just do it". The 6 seasons has discovered and brought many young talents into spot light for the first time;

2009 - 2011: Working as assistant teacher for the renowned expert Richard Moore (who first brought & promoted "marketing design" into Vietnam) at Gologo - the very first professional logo courses then.
typography: 2004: "CHU" - The first private conceptual typography exhibition in Hanoi, including 24 artworks.
2010 - 2015: Hosted more than 20 courses, workshops and talks about typography in Hanoi and HCM city;
2013: "Typeace"- 4 experimental typography workshops hold for students with designer Pham Dam Ca. Collected artworks were exhibited at Manzi art space - Hanoi;
2013: "Unlimited Letters" - group exhibition at "Zone 9 district" - modern art complex in Hanoi;
